lines.0: Namaste Aarav! Main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj cricket score jaise numerals 1 se 9 aur zero padhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
lines.1: Aarav, batting pasand hai—end mein isi par lautenge. Scoreboard par 3 runs hon, tum kaunsa numeral chunoge?
lines.2: Bilkul, 3! Screen par 3 collections hain; teen cricket balls gin kar numeral 3 milta hai. Ab 3 ungliyan dikhao.
lines.3: Haan, teen ungliyan. Ab screen ke 3 collections gino: ek, do, teen. Kaunsa numeral likhoge?
lines.4: Haan, 3. Ab socho: teen birds fly away, toh kitne birds bachenge?
lines.5: Haan, jab sab birds fly away, zero bachta hai. Ab aage kya karenge? Another flies away: ___ is left.
lines.6: Tumne zero socha, achchha checking ki. Ab aage kya karenge? Another flies away: ___ is left.
lines.7: Chalo, empty ten-frame dekho: sab boxes khaali hain. Number line par 0 se shuru karke objects ek-ek karke hatao. Ab aage kya karenge? Another flies away: ___ is
lines.8: Zero par tum tikey ho; ab objects ko ek-ek karke ginna sikhte hain. Taali, taali, taali, taali. Yeh kaun sa number hua?
lines.9: Tumne chaar kaise jaana—tumne taaliyon ko ek-ek karke gina tha?
lines.10: Bilkul, tumne har taali ko ek-ek baar ginkar chaar pehchaana. Main bolti hoon "eight". Ungliyon se 8 dikhao.
lines.11: Tumne ungliyan ek-ek karke gini—yeh sahi tareeka hai. Ab apna haath dekhkar ruk jao; card ka sawaal suno. Main bolti hoon "eight". Ungliyon se 8 dikhao.
lines.12: Apni dono hands use karke ungliyon ko ek-ek karke gino. Card par diye choices mein se ek choose karna. Main bolti hoon "eight". Ungliyon se 8 dikhao.
lines.13: Haan, 5 aur 3 milaakar tumne 8 ungliyan dikhayi. Tumhare ghar ka number 7 hai. Uske liye kitni taaliyaan bajaoge?
lines.14: Haan, bilkul—7 ke liye tumne saat taaliyan gini. Screen par 3 dots ka numeral kya hoga?
